_description: Historical rolling with wrap-around enabled. 60-year horizon (currentAge=30, lifeExpectancy=89) is shorter than the 97-year series, so without wrap there are 97-60+1=38 valid start years; with wrap every start year is valid (97 runs). Tests that historicalWrapEnabled=true expands the run count and that wrap-overrun reads from the start of the series.
_rationale: Pure accumulation: $500k Roth, no spending, no income, zero parametric inflation. With wrap, runs starting in 1965+ extend past 2024 and pull from 1928 onward — those years (Great Depression, WWII) materially affect the distribution. probability=100 because zero spending cannot deplete the balance. Median final balance after ~59 years of compounding 60/40 real returns lands in a very wide range.
name: Historical Rolling 60yr with wrap
